assessment_details.rationale: O has no matched CPO distributed-training regularizer or tied-alias mask/ref/index bookkeeping mechanism; the measured dead-alias storage defect remains outside O's software-agent control plane.
O has scoped evidence gates and repeated-decision safeguards, but no matched exact-range importance-sampling gain e-process that adaptively admits proposal distributions under multiplicity control.
O already distinguishes stale evidence and recovery/fallback states, but no matched separation between historical entry wealth and a fresh no-harm e-CUSUM fallback after proposal drift.
O has fail-closed fallback semantics, but no matched design that explicitly treats false defensive fallback as an efficiency-side ARL cost rather than a global safety-PFA event.
O recognizes stale state/distribution shift operationally, but no matched gradual-proxy-drift detector study showing long harm-detection delay under the same proposal-control mechanism.

O has invocation journals, idempotency and durable state, but no matched statistically bound ADMIT/SLOT/CLOSE journal where pre-score admission and post-CLOSE numerical reporting are operation-order invariants.

O persists directives, queues and execution state, but has no matched benchmark showing that lossy handoff can retain blocker words while weakening binding force, nor a tested structured-state/downstream-verification repair.
O has evaluators and reversible candidate control, but no matched co-evolving critic whose validity is explicitly version/failure-distribution bound with frozen-versus-evolving critic ablation.
O implements resumability, idempotency, postcondition-like checks and fenced recovery, but lacks the matched interface-only operability intervention benchmark reported by AFT-Bench.
O has Skills/Candidates and evidence, but no matched coalition-aware skill reliability scoring, skill masking/rebuild loop, or u-SMCO-style target probe.
O has durable traces and recovery classification, but no matched SymTrace/SymFail symbolic failure replay framework or source-verified runner.

O has fence/CAS/idempotency and effect evidence, but no matched split-scope proof stack separating transaction-local receiver-head evidence from global anti-equivocation while independently tracking authorization, correlation and physical effect.
O has no Bayesian duration-regime posterior or latent-cause detector driving dormant neural-memory restoration.
O has no adaptive online hazard posterior for neural duration-regime change detection or corresponding dormant-memory control.
O has durable replay, single-writer fencing and idempotency, but no matched shared projection-cursor reconciliation plus sink-owned canonical event identity across fresh sink/process instances.
O has replay/reconstruction mechanisms, but no matched all-generation rotated event-log bootstrap primitive with cursor-not-found full rebuild and explicit lock-order validation.
O has no monotone-coalition boundary antichain certifier or exact local clause-strengthening update rule.
O has no persistent ROBDD cardinality-by-rank certifier with incremental-vs-fresh rebuild equivalence testing.
O has no monotone-CNF-to-boundary embedding or OBDD/pathwidth lower-bound mechanism for its current evidence/skill control structures.
O has no clause-at-a-time knowledge-compilation core, though the worst-case incremental-vs-recompile separation is a new structural warning for any future such certifier.
O has no TDD/structured decision-diagram representation-switch mechanism or exact rank-count implementation.
O has no BDD node manager; the live-versus-historical allocation/garbage-collection distinction is outside the current implementation.

O explicitly requires exploration-bias detection and materially different methods, but lacks a matched coverage-reserve versus theory-conditioned sampling mechanism with representative held-out adjudication under misspecification.

O already has immutable Work request/response identity, journals and idempotency, but no matched logical evaluation/query identity above physical attempts with monotone statistical consumption across retries and process death.
